pull.title: Add team invitations with seven-day expiry
pull.body: Allow administrators to invite teammates. Includes persistence, expiry behavior, docs, and translated copy. Synthetic review fixture with deliberately incomplete migration and tenant scoping.

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,4 @@
+# Team invitations
+
+Admins can invite team members from the Members page.
+Invitations expire after seven days.
